script_text: Something shifts quietly beneath your feet this week — Taurus, Earth energy runs deep even when nothing looks different. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of love, sparking creative confidence and romantic attraction. Thursday is your worst day — Mercury squares Pluto in your 3rd House, creating communication chaos. Trust your instincts this week. Follow for daily updates.
